description: A kitchen tap fills a blue balloon inside a glass jar. All injected water is retained by an explicitly idealized pressure/volume constraint; no overflow is simulated or displayed.

solver.membrane: XPBD triangle-edge latex membrane, colour-group Gauss-Seidel, bending springs across interior edges
solver.water: incompressible volume; free-surface height solved each step so the enclosed volume below it equals the poured volume
solver.loading: hydrostatic pressure rho*g*(H - z) below the water line; water mass lumped onto the wetted latex
solver.mouth: Visually open, but retain_all imposes idealized no-discharge behavior; not a physical open-mouth pressure boundary.
solver.water_retention: retain_all: poured volume equals retained volume; spilled volume is always zero. Once full, a unilateral wet-volume constraint supplies additional pressure to stretch the membrane.
solver.overflow_display: Disabled by zero discharge. No exterior water film or counter puddle is generated.
solver.retention_limit: No burst model. Finite jar wall/floor contacts remain active. Current input range must be verified; unlimited water in a finite jar is not physically possible.

physical_setup.balloon_location: inside jar, neck rolled over the jar lip

elastic_material_edit.mapping: All elastic spring energies share one positive dimensionless scale; U_s(x) = s U_1(x).
elastic_material_edit.shear: implicit in the triangulated edge network, not a separately adjustable spring
elastic_material_edit.poisson_ratio: emergent from the discrete network, not independently prescribed
elastic_material_edit.limits: Relative discrete-model E/E0 only; absolute E in Pa and a continuum Poisson ratio are not calibrated.

render.environment: BlenderKit 'Modern Living and Kitchen Interior' (dark marble island, undermount sink)
render.tap: asset tap 'Kitchen tap balck' scaled 1.5x about its base and swung so the outlet is over the jar axis
render.stream: free-fall column from the outlet to each frame's water line, radius ~ v^-1/2
render.latex_shading: colour and translucency driven by per-vertex areal stretch
render.compositor_edit: asset Hue Correct node muted (it desaturated blues)

acceptance.counterfactual_limits: Every case must retain all injected water, have zero discharge and sufficient membrane capacity within 0.1 mL. No claim of physical open-mouth hydrodynamics or full CFD. Each changed trajectory requires new surfaces, rendering and visual review.
